question: On starts built from a first seed, one link distinction and a second seed, with the first seed and the place of the link held fixed, under 18 listed laws and two knot laws: does what the first seed's own descent makes differ with the form of the second seed; is the difference carried by the link; does any of it enter after the first round; is the class more than a function of the held knot; does the first seed's line differ in fate; and how far into a chain does it see?
inputs: The claim, the definitions (FF) and the pre-registration; the two data files (the seeds as explicit knots; what the drafter's probe saw); the definitions of WHAT-A-BIRTH-CARRIES-20261125-001 ticket B (BD2) and what they rest on, for the growth; ticket B's engine, unchanged and read-only, as the shared growth engine; the engine of PARTS-MEET-AGAIN-20261124-001A, unchanged and read-only, for the second growth of the gate; ticket B's knot-test routine.
forbidden_inputs: For the program's author: the drafter's probe programs and their outputs, namely everything under research/WHAT-A-BIRTH-CARRIES-20261125-001/checks/ and the drafter's scratch, beyond what the pre-registration and disclosed.json state. Any definition changed after a value is seen; any change to a frozen engine; any seed, first seed, law or run left out or added after its outcome is seen.
primary_observable: For every run: what the first seed's descent makes round by round (FF 5), the wider record (FF 5b), the rounds read, the births by descent and the last round a start knot is a member. For every study: R*, the classes among the forms by both records, the pairs first told apart by round and after the first round, the count profile, the fates on the window. For the chains: the depth table.
comparators_or_controls: The bare start; the unlinked start of every held-out pair of seeds (negative control); renumberings of sampled starts; the knot test on sampled runs; a second growth of sampled runs by an earlier engine, and every take recomputed from the rule's words; the knot law swapped to parity on the held-out material; exact replication of the drafter's probe on the material it ran.
resource_budget: One cap for the whole ticket: 60 minutes of wall time on at most 8 processes, each under a memory cap of 6 GB; 9 rounds (10 for the chains), a stop after the first round leaving more than 3,000 knots, the engine's guard limits as in ticket B. A run timed first at its own settings; a cut is a prefix of the registered order, recorded before the run, and what is not run is reported as not run.
first_executable_signal: The gate R0: the three starts of FF 2 reproduced; 400 sampled runs with the same structure under a second growth or with every take as the rule says.
decision_rule: Each prediction is judged by its 'Fails when' entry. Replication rows are exact. Sanity checks are labelled as such. If the unlinked control fails, no other row is read as registered. No row is conditioned on the sampled knot test.
stop_rule: Stop when every registered run within the cap is done and every prediction is judged, holds or fails, or is reported as not run. No run is added after its outcome is seen.
nonclaims: A study of starts built by hand: the meeting of the two seeds is supplied by a start distinction. Not a claim about two parts the growth made that meet through a knot the growth made, which is the fold of emergence and stays open. 'Differs with' is all that is shown: nothing reads a form in a fuller sense. The held-out material is of the same kinds as the material the drafter saw. No weighting is named. An independent reading on a shared growth engine, not an independent engine. No claim about living things, minds, physics or time.
